campaign.title: Rename CASE005_CREDIT preserving semantic identity and call bindings.

initial.code:
FUNCTION CASE005_CREDIT(X)
  CASE005_CREDIT = 0
  IF (X >= 0) THEN
    CASE005_CREDIT = 1
  END IF
  CASE005_CREDIT = CASE005_CREDIT
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION CASE005_MINOR(X)
  CASE005_MINOR = 0
  IF (X < 26) THEN
    CASE005_MINOR = 1
  END IF
  CASE005_MINOR = CASE005_MINOR
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION CASE005_ELIGIBLE(X)
  CASE005_ELIGIBLE = 0
  IF (CASE005_CREDIT(X) >= 1) THEN
    CASE005_ELIGIBLE = 1
  END IF
  IF (CASE005_MINOR(X) >= 1) THEN
    CASE005_ELIGIBLE = 0
  END IF
  CASE005_ELIGIBLE = CASE005_ELIGIBLE
END FUNCTION
